panels.title: Autonomie lors de la meilleure saison
panels.description: Autonomie réelle batterie pleine (capacité actuelle / consommation) lors de la saison où la consommation est la plus basse. Les saisons sont des blocs de trois mois : Déc–Fév, Mars–Mai, Juin–Août, Sep–Nov. Les tuiles ci-dessous indiquent de quelle saison il s'agit.

targets.rawSql:
WITH eff AS (
        SELECT COALESCE(derived, car_eff)::float8 AS e FROM (
          SELECT ROUND((cp.charge_energy_added / NULLIF(cp.end_rated_range_km
                   - cp.start_rated_range_km, 0))::numeric, 3) AS derived,
                 COUNT(*) AS n, cars.efficiency AS car_eff
          FROM cars
          LEFT JOIN charging_processes cp ON cp.car_id = cars.id
            AND cp.duration_min > 10 AND cp.end_battery_level <= 95
            AND cp.start_rated_range_km IS NOT NULL
            AND cp.end_rated_range_km IS NOT NULL
            AND cp.charge_energy_added > 0
          WHERE cars.id = $car_id
          GROUP BY 1, 3 ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1 LIMIT 1) x),
drv AS (
        SELECT d.id, d.start_date, d.end_date, d.distance::float8 AS km,
               d.duration_min, d.outside_temp_avg AS temp,
               d.ascent, d.descent,
               ((d.start_rated_range_km - d.end_rated_range_km) * eff.e)::float8
                 AS kwh
        FROM drives d CROSS JOIN eff
        WHERE d.car_id = $car_id AND d.end_date IS NOT NULL
          AND d.distance > 0 AND d.start_rated_range_km IS NOT NULL
          AND d.end_rated_range_km IS NOT NULL),
cap AS (
        SELECT cp.id, cp.end_date AS t, pos.odometer::float8 AS odo,
               (c.rated_battery_range_km * eff.e * 100.0
                 / c.usable_battery_level)::float8 AS cap
        FROM charging_processes cp
        CROSS JOIN eff
        JOIN LATERAL (
          SELECT rated_battery_range_km, usable_battery_level FROM charges
          WHERE charging_process_id = cp.id AND usable_battery_level > 0
            AND rated_battery_range_km IS NOT NULL
          ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 1) c ON true
        LEFT JOIN positions pos ON pos.id = cp.position_id
        WHERE cp.car_id = $car_id AND cp.end_date IS NOT NULL
          AND cp.charge_energy_added >= eff.e * 100),
s AS (SELECT ((EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ((start_date) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE '$__timezone'))::int % 12) / 3) AS b, SUM(kwh) / SUM(km) AS kwh_km,
             AVG(temp) AS temp
      FROM drv WHERE $__timeFilter(start_date) AND temp IS NOT NULL
      GROUP BY 1 HAVING SUM(km) >= 100 AND SUM(kwh) > 0),
x AS (SELECT (SELECT MAX(kwh_km) FROM s) AS worst,
             (SELECT MIN(kwh_km) FROM s) AS best,
             (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM s) AS n, (SELECT percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY cap) FROM (SELECT cap FROM cap WHERE t <= (now() AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') ORDER BY t DESC LIMIT 10) z) AS cap)
SELECT CASE WHEN n >= 2 THEN convert_km((cap / best)::numeric, '$length_unit') END AS "range__$length_unit" FROM x

panels.title: Consommation mensuelle et température extérieure
panels.description: Consommation par mois (axe de gauche) comparée à la température extérieure moyenne des trajets du mois (axe de droite). La consommation augmente normalement quand la température baisse.

targets.rawSql:
WITH eff AS (
        SELECT COALESCE(derived, car_eff)::float8 AS e FROM (
          SELECT ROUND((cp.charge_energy_added / NULLIF(cp.end_rated_range_km
                   - cp.start_rated_range_km, 0))::numeric, 3) AS derived,
                 COUNT(*) AS n, cars.efficiency AS car_eff
          FROM cars
          LEFT JOIN charging_processes cp ON cp.car_id = cars.id
            AND cp.duration_min > 10 AND cp.end_battery_level <= 95
            AND cp.start_rated_range_km IS NOT NULL
            AND cp.end_rated_range_km IS NOT NULL
            AND cp.charge_energy_added > 0
          WHERE cars.id = $car_id
          GROUP BY 1, 3 ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1 LIMIT 1) x),
drv AS (
        SELECT d.id, d.start_date, d.end_date, d.distance::float8 AS km,
               d.duration_min, d.outside_temp_avg AS temp,
               d.ascent, d.descent,
               ((d.start_rated_range_km - d.end_rated_range_km) * eff.e)::float8
                 AS kwh
        FROM drives d CROSS JOIN eff
        WHERE d.car_id = $car_id AND d.end_date IS NOT NULL
          AND d.distance > 0 AND d.start_rated_range_km IS NOT NULL
          AND d.end_rated_range_km IS NOT NULL)
SELECT ((date_trunc('month', ((start_date) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE '$__timezone'))) AT TIME ZONE '$__timezone') AS time,
       SUM(kwh) * 1000 / NULLIF(convert_km((SUM(km))::numeric, '$length_unit'), 0) AS "consumption__wh_$length_unit",
       convert_celsius((AVG(temp))::numeric, '$temp_unit') AS "temp__$temp_unit"
FROM drv WHERE $__timeFilter(start_date) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Autonomie perdue par jour à l'arrêt
panels.description: Autonomie perdue à l'arrêt, par 24 heures de stationnement, pour chaque saison (selon le jour où le stationnement a commencé). Rouge : la saison qui perd le plus.

targets.rawSql:
WITH eff AS (
        SELECT COALESCE(derived, car_eff)::float8 AS e FROM (
          SELECT ROUND((cp.charge_energy_added / NULLIF(cp.end_rated_range_km
                   - cp.start_rated_range_km, 0))::numeric, 3) AS derived,
                 COUNT(*) AS n, cars.efficiency AS car_eff
          FROM cars
          LEFT JOIN charging_processes cp ON cp.car_id = cars.id
            AND cp.duration_min > 10 AND cp.end_battery_level <= 95
            AND cp.start_rated_range_km IS NOT NULL
            AND cp.end_rated_range_km IS NOT NULL
            AND cp.charge_energy_added > 0
          WHERE cars.id = $car_id
          GROUP BY 1, 3 ORDER BY 2 DESC, 1 LIMIT 1) x),
park AS (
        SELECT x.t0, x.t1, x.temp, x.geofence_id, x.address_id,
               EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (x.t1 - x.t0)) / 3600.0 AS hours,
               GREATEST(x.p0 - x.p1, 0)::float8 AS loss_km,
               (GREATEST(x.r0 - x.r1, 0) * eff.e)::float8 AS loss_kwh
        FROM (
          SELECT d.end_date AS t0, LEAD(d.start_date) OVER w AS t1,
                 d.end_rated_range_km AS r0,
                 LEAD(d.start_rated_range_km) OVER w AS r1,
                 d.end_${preferred_range}_range_km AS p0,
                 LEAD(d.start_${preferred_range}_range_km) OVER w AS p1,
                 COALESCE((d.outside_temp_avg
                   + LEAD(d.outside_temp_avg) OVER w) / 2,
                   d.outside_temp_avg) AS temp,
                 d.end_geofence_id AS geofence_id,
                 d.end_address_id AS address_id
          FROM drives d
          WHERE d.car_id = $car_id AND d.end_date IS NOT NULL
          WINDOW w AS (ORDER BY d.start_date)) x
        CROSS JOIN eff
        WHERE x.t1 IS NOT NULL AND x.r0 IS NOT NULL AND x.r1 IS NOT NULL
          AND x.t1 - x.t0 BETWEEN interval '1 hour' AND interval '30 days'
          AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM charging_processes c
            WHERE c.car_id = $car_id AND c.start_date < x.t1
              AND COALESCE(c.end_date, c.start_date) > x.t0)),
a AS (SELECT ((EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ((t0) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE '$__timezone'))::int % 12) / 3) AS b, convert_km((SUM(loss_km))::numeric, '$length_unit') * 24 / NULLIF(SUM(hours), 0)::numeric AS v FROM park
      WHERE $__timeFilter(t0) GROUP BY 1)
SELECT season.label, a.v AS "loss__${length_unit}_day"
FROM (VALUES (0, 'Déc–Fév'), (1, 'Mars–Mai'), (2, 'Juin–Août'), (3, 'Sep–Nov')) season(b, label) JOIN a USING (b) WHERE a.v IS NOT NULL ORDER BY season.b

panels.title: Rendement de charge
panels.description: Part de l'énergie tirée des bornes qui est parvenue à la batterie pour chaque saison. Vert : la saison la plus efficace.

targets.rawSql:
WITH chg AS (
        SELECT cp.id, cp.start_date, cp.end_date, cp.geofence_id,
               cp.charge_energy_added::float8 AS added,
               GREATEST(cp.charge_energy_used, cp.charge_energy_added)::float8
                 AS used,
               cp.cost::float8 AS cost, cp.duration_min,
               cp.outside_temp_avg AS temp,
               cp.start_battery_level AS soc0, cp.end_battery_level AS soc1,
               COALESCE(g.name, a.name, a.road, a.city, 'Inconnu') AS place,
               CASE WHEN k.is_dc THEN 'DC'
                    WHEN cp.geofence_id IN ($home) THEN 'Home'
                    ELSE 'Public AC' END AS kind
        FROM charging_processes cp
        LEFT JOIN geofences g ON g.id = cp.geofence_id
        LEFT JOIN addresses a ON a.id = cp.address_id
        LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
          SELECT COALESCE(bool_or(fast_charger_present), false) AS is_dc
          FROM charges WHERE charging_process_id = cp.id) k ON true
        WHERE cp.car_id = $car_id AND cp.end_date IS NOT NULL
          AND cp.charge_energy_added > 0),
a AS (SELECT ((EXTRACT(MONTH FROM ((start_date) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE '$__timezone'))::int % 12) / 3) AS b, SUM(added) * 100 / NULLIF(SUM(used), 0) AS v FROM chg
      WHERE $__timeFilter(start_date) GROUP BY 1)
SELECT season.label, a.v AS efficiency
FROM (VALUES (0, 'Déc–Fév'), (1, 'Mars–Mai'), (2, 'Juin–Août'), (3, 'Sep–Nov')) season(b, label) JOIN a USING (b) WHERE a.v IS NOT NULL ORDER BY season.b
